reason: the tensorrt python package is not installed (No module named 'tensorrt'). TensorRT engine builds need a NVIDIA gpu, the cuda runtime, and the tensorrt python package. None of those exist on Apple Silicon or on any cpu only host. Run this on a cuda machine through the gpu image this repository ships, with docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.tensorrt -t adrankbench-trt . and then docker run --gpus all adrankbench-trt. That image is built on nvcr.io/nvidia/tensorrt:25.01-py3, which carries TensorRT 10 and the cuda runtime already installed.
